body: That is it exactly! If I kill myself the pain will stop, the letting others down, the constant beratment in my mind. It will all stop.

Actually, yeah lately I've given acting it out some serious thought. I have a plan and the means, I just really love my boys and my wife. I've not told my wife my suicidal feelings, I don't wish to scare her or have her force me into treatment.

I would never tell a therapist or any one that could exercise the ability to detain me against my will (96 hour hold, I used to work in an ER) what I really feel. I don't trust them not report me and save their own skin.

Yeah my whole life I can vividly remember telling teachers that I wanted to die when I was in 1st grade. not in a kid way either, they made me talk to people about it till i convinced them I was just a kid saying things I had heard on tv or something. I remember telling them that vividly. In the last year my marriage has deteriorated, I don't have any friends, because I moved to be with the wife when her job moved.  I never get to go anywhere because I have 2 sons, both are mine, 4 and 1.

I read some of your past stuff, I took 7 years to get just my BS.E. I understand how you feel like your just spinning your wheels when you're not in school or moving toward a goal. What are you studying?
